title: RoboMIND: Benchmark on Multi-embodiment Intelligence Normative Data for Robot Manipulation
relevance_to_failure_intervention_data: Direct evidence that large embodied datasets are starting to keep explicit failure demonstrations.
key_evidence: 107k teleoperation trajectories; includes 5k real-world failure demonstrations with detailed causes for failure reflection and correction.
notes: Important China-linked dataset; verify released failure labels in downloadable files.

title: Oopsie Data
relevance_to_failure_intervention_data: Direct evidence of a multi-lab effort dedicated to collecting manipulation failures.
key_evidence: Frames failures as useful for offline RL, policy steering, failure prediction, bottleneck recognition, and human-intervention requests.
notes: Early-stage public project; dataset scale and release timing need tracking.

title: Oopsie Quickstart Guide
relevance_to_failure_intervention_data: Shows an explicit workflow for recording successes and failures and annotating each failed trajectory.
key_evidence: Supports in-the-loop collection, bulk collection, custom conversion, annotation, validation, and upload.
notes: Useful as SOP reference for a domestic failure-data service.

title: Oopsie Dataset Format
relevance_to_failure_intervention_data: Concrete schema for success/failure labels and failure taxonomy.
key_evidence: HDF5 per episode; episode annotations include success, failure_description, taxonomy, severity, observations, states, and actions; export planned to RLDS/LeRobot.
notes: Good schema baseline for raw-to-trainable conversion.

title: Human-In-the-Loop Data Collection
relevance_to_failure_intervention_data: LeRobot has first-class HIL/DAgger collection support for intervention data.
key_evidence: Records autonomous segments plus recovery/correction movements; fine-tunes on combined demonstration and HIL data; supports repeated deploy-collect-fine-tune loops.
notes: Strong signal that open-source tooling is moving from success-only BC to intervention datasets.

title: LeRobot GitHub Repository
relevance_to_failure_intervention_data: LeRobot standardizes dataset storage and training but normal datasets are not necessarily failure-aware.
key_evidence: LeRobotDataset uses synchronized MP4/images, Parquet state/action data, and HF Hub hosting; HIL is a separate workflow.
notes: Use as export target, not as proof that all LeRobot datasets preserve failures.

title: A Reduction of Imitation Learning and Structured Prediction to No-Regret Online Learning
relevance_to_failure_intervention_data: Foundational DAgger method motivating on-policy correction data.
key_evidence: Addresses compounding errors by iteratively training on the distribution of observations induced by the learner.
notes: Conceptual root for intervention-data value.

title: HG-DAgger: Interactive Imitation Learning with Human Experts
relevance_to_failure_intervention_data: Shows why human-gated intervention is safer and more practical than labeling every learner state.
key_evidence: Human expert takes control when needed; evaluated on simulated and real autonomous driving; improves over DAgger and BC.
notes: Important bridge from AV takeover data to robot intervention data.

title: Precise and Dexterous Robotic Manipulation via Human-in-the-Loop Reinforcement Learning
relevance_to_failure_intervention_data: Evidence that human corrections plus online RL can materially improve real robot manipulation.
key_evidence: Combines demonstrations and human corrections; reaches near-perfect success rates in 1 to 2.5 hours; reports 2x success-rate improvement and 1.8x faster execution over baselines.
notes: HIL-SERL also collects positive/negative samples for reward classifier.

title: HIL-SERL Project Page
relevance_to_failure_intervention_data: Operational description of positive/negative samples and interventions.
key_evidence: Teleoperate to collect positive and negative samples; use binary classifier as sparse reward; provide interventions during online training.
notes: Good for how-to-use section.

title: RaC: Robot Learning for Long-Horizon Tasks by Scaling Recovery and Correction
relevance_to_failure_intervention_data: Strong evidence that recovery/correction is its own data composition beyond expert demos.
key_evidence: Human intervenes when failure appears imminent, rewinds to a familiar state, then provides corrective segment; outperforms prior SOTA using 10x less data collection time and samples.
notes: Recent work; track code/data release and independent reproduction.

title: pi*0.6: a VLA That Learns From Experience
relevance_to_failure_intervention_data: Evidence that VLA post-training uses demonstrations, on-policy experience, and expert interventions.
key_evidence: RECAP uses heterogeneous data including demonstrations, on-policy collection, and expert teleoperated interventions during autonomous execution.
notes: Recent proprietary-lab work; public details are useful for direction but commercial data asset remains opaque.

title: Learning while Deploying: Fleet-Scale Reinforcement Learning for Generalist Robot Policies
relevance_to_failure_intervention_data: Evidence that fleet deployment logs plus human interventions may become a post-training asset.
key_evidence: Uses autonomous rollouts and human interventions across a fleet of 16 dual-arm robots; improves average success to 95%.
notes: Very recent; verify code/data release and reproducibility.

title: Fleet-DAgger: Interactive Robot Fleet Learning with Scalable Human Supervision
relevance_to_failure_intervention_data: Frames remote human interventions as scarce fleet-learning supervision.
key_evidence: Industrial fleets at Amazon, Nimble, Plus One, Waymo, Zoox query remote teleoperators; proposes Return on Human Effort and Fleet-DAgger.
notes: Good analogy for ToB service economics and human-attention allocation.

title: Learning from Imperfect Demonstrations with Self-Supervision for Robotic Manipulation
relevance_to_failure_intervention_data: Directly argues failed/imperfect data is usually discarded but can improve policies if filtered.
key_evidence: SSDF scores failed trajectory segments and adds high-quality segments to training; improves success in ManiSkill2 and real Franka tasks.
notes: Useful method for converting failed demos into positive subsegments.

title: AHA: A Vision-Language-Model for Detecting and Reasoning over Failures in Robotic Manipulation
relevance_to_failure_intervention_data: Failure reasoning dataset and VLM for detection/explanation.
key_evidence: FailGen perturbs successful RLBench trajectories to generate failure demonstrations; includes failure modes such as grasp slip, translations, rotations, wrong sequence; improves downstream recovery/planning.
notes: Synthetic-heavy; watch sim-to-real limits.

title: RoboFAC: A Comprehensive Framework for Robotic Failure Analysis and Correction
relevance_to_failure_intervention_data: Failure-centric VLA supervision for diagnosis and correction.
key_evidence: 9,440 erroneous manipulation trajectories and 78,623 QA pairs across 53 scenes; failure categories; 29.1% relative improvement in real VLA pipeline.
notes: Dataset on HF has viewer issues; verify raw files and license before reuse.

title: Learning Actionable Manipulation Recovery via Counterfactual Failure Synthesis
relevance_to_failure_intervention_data: Shows a path to synthesize paired failure-correction data from successful real-world demos.
key_evidence: Dream2Fix generates 120k paired samples with verification filters; improves correction accuracy from 19.7% to 81.3%.
notes: Very recent; needs reproduction and source-code check.

title: Failure-Aware RL: Reliable Offline-to-Online Reinforcement Learning with Self-Recovery for Real-World Manipulation
organization_or_authors: Shanghai Qi Zhi Institute; SJTU; Tsinghua; NTU; A*STAR; UMD
relevance_to_failure_intervention_data: Treats intervention-requiring failures as a central online-RL safety bottleneck.
key_evidence: FARL trains recovery policy and world-model safety critic offline; reports 73.1% fewer intervention-requiring failures and 11.3% higher performance.
notes: China-relevant research team; track code and FailureBench release.

title: DROID: A Large-Scale In-The-Wild Robot Manipulation Dataset
relevance_to_failure_intervention_data: Important contrast: large in-the-wild demonstrations, but public abstract does not state failure labels are retained.
key_evidence: 76k demonstration trajectories, 350 hours, 564 scenes, 84 tasks, 50 collectors.
notes: Use as success/demo-heavy baseline; verify if raw metadata has success flags or discarded failed attempts.

title: Universal Manipulation Interface GitHub Repository
relevance_to_failure_intervention_data: UMI pipeline exposes data-quality drops such as SLAM failures, but not a public failure-recovery labeling scheme.
key_evidence: Example SLAM pipeline reports percent of usable raw data and n_dropped_demos; training uses processed Zarr.
notes: Useful for distinguishing sensor/pipeline failure from task failure.

title: Mobile ALOHA: Learning Bimanual Mobile Manipulation with Low-Cost Whole-Body Teleoperation
relevance_to_failure_intervention_data: Success-demo-focused mobile manipulation baseline.
key_evidence: Uses Mobile ALOHA teleoperation and behavior cloning; 50 demonstrations per task; co-training improves success rates.
notes: Does not advertise preserved failed trajectories in abstract.

title: Learning Fine-Grained Bimanual Manipulation with Low-Cost Hardware
relevance_to_failure_intervention_data: ALOHA/ACT demonstrates low-cost teleoperation data value but is not failure-centric.
key_evidence: ACT addresses compounding errors; reports 80-90% success with around 10 minutes of demos on six tasks.
notes: Useful as hardware/data-collection baseline.

title: ADAS-TO: A Large-Scale Multimodal Naturalistic Dataset and Empirical Characterization of Human Takeovers during ADAS Engagement
relevance_to_failure_intervention_data: Autonomous-driving analogy for takeover-centered public datasets.
key_evidence: 15,659 takeover-centered 20s clips from 327 drivers across 22 brands; labels trigger type and safety-critical cases.
notes: Use as analogy, not direct robot-manipulation evidence.

title: California DMV Disengagement Reports
relevance_to_failure_intervention_data: Official proof that intervention/disengagement logs are institutionalized in autonomous driving.
key_evidence: AV permit holders must track and report disengagements from autonomous mode during testing.
notes: Shows governance and reporting pattern domestic robot fleets may eventually need.

title: TalosHub Manufacturing Training Data for Robots
relevance_to_failure_intervention_data: Commercial signal that exception/recovery labels are being packaged as robotics data products.
key_evidence: Claims manufacturing task packs include multi-view video, machine-state alignment, phase segmentation, exception coverage, recovery annotations, success/failure labels, QA gates, and loaders.
notes: Company claims need customer/reference verification; useful market-signal source.

title: Deployment-Time Reliability of Learned Robot Policies
relevance_to_failure_intervention_data: Frames deployment-time failures as inputs for monitoring, diagnosis, and data curation.
key_evidence: Proposes runtime failure monitoring and tracing deployment successes/failures to influential training demonstrations for dataset curation.
notes: Good conceptual support for failure logs as curation assets.

title: RoboMD: Uncovering Robot Vulnerabilities through Semantic Potential Fields
relevance_to_failure_intervention_data: Uses limited success-failure data to find vulnerable regions before real failures happen.
key_evidence: Learns vulnerability prediction in a vision-language embedding and fine-tunes with discovered vulnerabilities.
notes: Useful for active failure mining and pre-deployment stress testing.
